name: Table

props.name: isSortable
props.description: `false` If true, will apply sorting styles

props.name: overflowMenuOnHover
props.description: Specify whether the overflow menu (if it exists) should be shown always, or only on hover

props.name: size
props.description: Change the row height of table. Currently supports `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, and `xl`.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: `false` If true, will keep the header sticky (only data rows will scroll)

props.name: useStaticWidth
props.description: If `true`, sets the table width to `auto` instead of `100%`.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon Table rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
